user.title: GAC Connect
user.description: Beta: unofficial, with limited testing. Remote commands act on your vehicle; use at your own risk. Sign in with the mobile number on your GAC account. You'll solve a slide puzzle and enter a code sent by SMS.

data_description.mobile: For Thailand, enter 08… / 09… / 06… or +66…; both formats are accepted.

sms.title: Enter the SMS code
sms.description: Enter the code just sent to your phone.

remote_controls.title: Remote controls
remote_controls.description: Choose which remote controls Home Assistant may use for {model}. Sensors and controls are matched to the car's own capability list. Each can be changed later in the integration options.

data_description.experimental_pinless_unlock: Allow the Doors control to unlock the car. No PIN required. Leave off to use this control for locking only.
data_description.allow_charger_unlock: Show the Unlock charging connector button. Unlocking lets anyone pull the charging cable out, and unlocking while charging affects the charging power. There is no remote command to lock it again. Off by default.
data_description.allow_vehicle_shutdown: Show the Turn vehicle off button and allow shutdown commands. Off by default. Enabling this setting does not send a command.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in again
reauth_confirm.description: Sign in to GAC again to renew the session. Your entities and settings stay as they are. Signing in here may sign the GAC app out on your phone.

cards.title: Dashboard cards
cards.description: GAC Connect comes with six dashboard cards for {model}. They are installed only if you choose them; until then GAC Connect adds nothing to Home Assistant's pages. Once installed, they can be added to any dashboard, and GAC Connect also creates a dashboard for the car with the cards picked below (pick none to skip it). Both can be changed later under Configure → Dashboard cards.

data_description.dashboard_cards: Used only when the cards are installed.

finish.title: Finish setup
finish.description: Refresh your browser after setup so the cards load.

progress.captcha: Solve the slide puzzle in the window that opened, then return here.

settings.title: GAC Connect options
settings.description: Sensors and controls are matched to the car's capability list and its reports. Use Always show and Omit to override them.

data_description.allow_plaintext_push: Off by default. If GAC offers only a plaintext broker, enabling this sends the broker credentials and topic names without TLS, which allows network interception or forged results. On GAC's Southeast Asia service they include an account number, but not the VIN or phone number. Polling continues when disabled.
data_description.experimental_pinless_unlock: Allow the Doors control to unlock the car. No PIN required. Leave off to use this control for locking only.
data_description.allow_charger_unlock: Show the Unlock charging connector button. Unlocking lets anyone pull the charging cable out, and unlocking while charging affects the charging power. There is no remote command to lock it again. Off by default.
data_description.allow_account_alerts: Read GAC's alert list every 10 minutes (charging connector not plugged in, charging failed, someone left in the car, 12 V battery low, anti-theft and others) and fire a GAC alert event for each new one. GAC allows one account sign-in: this uses Home Assistant's, so it stops when the GAC app signs in on your phone (the Last GAC alert sensor then shows Signed out), and signing Home Assistant in again (Reconfigure) signs the app out. Off by default.
data_description.allow_vehicle_shutdown: Show the Turn vehicle off button and allow shutdown commands. Off by default. Enabling this setting does not send a command; the Vehicle power sensor remains available when it is off.
data_description.enable_entities: Show these entities even if the car does not appear to have them. Omit and the fridge and location settings still take priority; remote unlocking, connector unlock and shutdown need their Allow settings.
data_description.omit_entities: Hide these entities even if the car has them. Existing entities are disabled while selected and return with the same IDs if you clear them.
data_description.track_parked: Show the car's location while it is switched off. With either location setting on, the Home/Away location tracker and a GPS coordinates sensor are added; with both off, neither is shown. Coordinates remain redacted in downloaded diagnostics.
data_description.track_moving: Show the car's location while it is switched on. The car reports no speed or gear, so switched on counts as moving, even when stationary. While the car is in a state you do not track, both location entities show unknown and no position is recorded.

init.title: GAC Connect
init.description: Vehicle settings are saved when you submit them. You can open another panel here, or close this dialog when finished.

equipment.title: Detected equipment
equipment.description:
Which entities are shown, and why.

{equipment}

capabilities.title: Refresh vehicle capabilities
capabilities.description: Read the list of features your car offers remotely from GAC's service, and show or hide entities to match. Do this after a software update or if entities look wrong. Your Omit and Always show choices still apply. One request; no command is sent to the car.

charging.title: Charging schedule
charging.description:
{schedule}

Submitting a charging action returns here after the request is accepted, not after the car confirms it. Check Last command for the outcome.

charge_now.title: Charge whenever plugged in
charge_now.description: Submitting allows the car to charge whenever it is plugged in, overriding scheduled mode. This sends a command to the car. It does not guarantee charging starts immediately. Check Last command and the vehicle’s next report for the outcome.

charge_window.title: Send a charging window
charge_window.description: The current values reported by the car are prefilled. Choose times in {timezone} and select the days, then submit to update the schedule. Check Last command for the outcome.

data.until_soc: Stop at the car’s target charge level

data_description.stop: Use 24-hour time, for example 05:00. An earlier stop time runs into the following day. Start and stop must differ. Not needed when stopping at the target charge level.
data_description.days: Leave empty for a one-time charge (the app’s Once). Select days to repeat, or all seven for every day. For an overnight window, select the day charging starts.
data_description.until_soc: Use the car’s existing target instead of the stop time. This integration cannot read or change that target; verify it in the car or official app.

cards.title: Dashboard cards
cards.description:
{status}

Installed, the cards can be added to any dashboard; not installed, GAC Connect adds nothing to Home Assistant's pages. With the cards installed, choose the cards on this car's dashboard. Pick none to remove it; an edited dashboard is kept. Refresh your browser after a change.

data_description.dashboard_cards: Used only when the cards are installed.

error.conflicting_entity_choices: An entity cannot be in both Always show and Omit. Remove it from one list.
error.invalid_quiet_time: Enter a time from 00:00 to 23:59 in HH:MM format.
error.quiet_pair_required: Set both quiet-hour times, or clear both to disable quiet hours.
error.quiet_times_equal: Start and end must differ. Clear both to disable quiet hours.
error.charge_window_closing: This window ends before the car could start it: a start that has already passed is sent from the next minute. Choose a later stop time.
error.invalid_charge_window: Enter a start time and, unless stopping at the target charge level, a different stop time, in HH:MM format (00:00–23:59), and choose valid days.
error.command_failed: The request failed. Open Last command for the failure reason and service code, and check Polling status before trying again.
error.capability_read_failed: The capability list could not be read. Equipment is still detected from the car's reports; try again later.
error.dashboard_edited: This car's dashboard has been edited, so GAC Connect will not change or remove it. Change it on the dashboard itself, or delete it there.
error.confirmation_required: Tick Remove the dashboard to confirm, or close this dialog to keep it.

get_position.description: Read the car’s separate position report, including speed and heading where the car sends them. Latitude, longitude and address values are masked. This sends no vehicle control.

get_alerts.name: Read car alerts
get_alerts.description: Read one page of the car’s alert history (charging finished, scheduled charging without a connector, someone left in the car, 12 V battery low, doors or windows left open and others). This sends no vehicle control.
